conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 1. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 124 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 123 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 118 | 700 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
